description: This file defines a React component for viewing, editing, and deleting individual notes in a note-taking web application. It includes server-side loader and action functions to fetch a note by ID and handle deletion requests.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads a single note by ID after verifying user session.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles note deletion based on form submission.

methods.name: NoteDetails
methods.description: React component for displaying note details with options to edit or delete.
